post.description:

Send the `corridor_id` (for example `SG-PH`) and the `amount` in the sending currency. Each
service's fee and rate markup come from the World Bank's Remittance Prices Worldwide survey
(a published survey, not a live price list); the mid-market rate is the cron's latest. The
result carries the survey period and the attribution the World Bank requires wherever the
prices are shown. A service workers have reported on the Exploitation Radar is marked
`flagged` but keeps its rank. No Gemini call, so only the API-wide rate limit applies.

past days and kept up by the rate cron; `providers` names any other source used. The best
day compares each weekday with its own week over the last 52 weeks, and stays null with a
reason when the history is too short or no weekday is reliably better. One Firestore read,
no Gemini call, so only the API-wide rate limit applies.

post.summary: Check a pasted message or a screenshot for a scam
post.description:
Say whether a message is a scam, of which type, how risky, and which words gave it away.

Send the message as JSON (`text`, `language`, `corridor_id`), or a screenshot as
`multipart/form-data` (`image`, `language`, `corridor_id`). The message is masked (phone
numbers, emails, IDs, accounts, links) before anything else happens, and only the masked
text is returned. Its content is data: instructions inside it are never followed. A
screenshot is read once and discarded; it is never stored. A scam also gets an explainer
in the worker's language, and up to three known scams and Radar reports it resembles
(`similar`, `corridor_report_count`); if either cannot be made it is left empty and the
verdict is still returned.

The masked text is stored as the worker's check and found again by its hash: the same
message in the same language is answered from storage (`cached: true`) with no Gemini call
and no use of the hourly budget. A new message spends one of the worker's 20 checks an
hour; a screenshot always does, because it is read by Gemini first.

text.title: Text
text.description: The message exactly as received. Not cut: over the limit is a 422.

language.title: Language
language.description: The worker's language: the explainer is written in it.

corridor_id.title: Corridor Id
corridor_id.description: The worker's route; defaults to the one in their profile.

schema.title: ScamAnalyzeTextRequest
schema.description:
Body of `POST /api/v2/scam/analyze` for a pasted message (`application/json`).

A screenshot goes as `multipart/form-data` with an `image` file and the same `language` and
`corridor_id` fields; it has no model here because a file is not JSON.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP screenshot, at most 5 MB

404.description: The `scam` flag is off for the caller

415.description: Body is neither JSON nor a form, or the image is not JPEG, PNG or WebP

422.description: Empty text, text over 4,000 characters, a language outside the six, no image, or no message text could be read from the image (`image_unreadable`)

429.description: The worker has used 20 checks that call Gemini this hour (a repeated message answered from storage does not count), or 60 calls a minute; see Retry-After

get.summary: The worker's scam-check history, newest first
get.description:
The checks this worker made, newest first, a page at a time.

Each row is what a history screen needs: the verdict's headline, the first 140 characters of
the masked text and whether the worker already warned others. Pass the `next_cursor` of a
page as `cursor` for the next one; `null` means the end. A check past its expiry is not
listed.

was made shows its current count. A check that does not exist, has expired or belongs to

post.summary: Warn other workers: report a scam check to Exploitation Radar
post.description:
Report the scam in one of the worker's checks, exactly as the confirmation sheet showed.

Only the `indicator_ids` the worker left ticked and the text they confirmed (masked again
here) are sent to Radar; no uid, reporter hash, check id or raw message is stored with the
report. A check is reported once: a repeat returns the first report with `200` and
`already_reported: true`, and counts nothing a second time. The Radar profile of the scam
type is `/radar/entity/{entity_slug}`.

workers have not flagged (`recommender.recommended_provider`), set by code: nothing here is

RemittanceSavings.title: RemittanceSavings
RemittanceSavings.description:
Response of `GET /api/v1/remittance/savings` (NF-P2-022): step 8 of the pipeline.

Compares the best and the worst comparable service of the corridor over the last
`months_used` full calendar months, each at that month's average mid-market rate. The two
services are the same every month (the survey's fees are one quarter, not a history), so
only the rate changes month to month; `total_savings` is what sending with `best_firm`
instead of `worst_firm` would have been worth over the period — the "you would have saved
$X" figure.

TransferLogRequest.title: TransferLogRequest
TransferLogRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/remittance/log`.

`comparison` is the unmodified response of `/remittance/compare`; every stored amount is
read from its `rpw_id` provider, never typed freely by the client, the same as the
recommendation step never trusting a provider name Gemini wrote.

TransferLogResponse.title: TransferLogResponse
TransferLogResponse.description:
Response of `POST /api/v1/remittance/log` (NF-P2-017): the stored transfer.

Feeds the Financial Identity Builder (`users/{uid}/transfers`, `fib.md` in the data model).
